title: Hotel Revenue Management Simulation Game
summary: A web-based educational simulation game for hotel revenue management, powered by ML models trained on 261K+ real hotel booking records to drive demand, pricing, and guest behavior. Its demand_model pipeline trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on real guest profile data to generate correlated synthetic guest profiles, and evaluates them with SDV's evaluate_quality() and run_diagnostic().
